rules.quote: Keep the hierarchy shallow – use no more than 4 heading levels.
rules.violation_condition: Hierarchically structured content uses more than 4 heading levels.
rules.why: G-2: keeping the hierarchy shallow and limiting it to 4 heading levels are one check.

rules.specification: Interpret a clear title as one whose wording makes the page's subject identifiable. The manual gives no more specific clarity criteria here.
rules.violation_condition: A page title has unclear wording that leaves the page's subject difficult to identify.
rules.why: G-4: retain the instruction; the following sentence explains its accessibility and search benefits.

rules.quote: Organise content in a clear order using section headings.
rules.specification: The manual requires a clear order but does not specify criteria for choosing or assessing that order.
rules.violation_condition: Content lacks a clearly ordered, heading-based section structure.
rules.why: G-1: retain the concrete requirement for heading-based organisation rather than an additional broad section-level rule.

rules.quote: Describe the topics or the following section in the headings.
rules.violation_condition: A heading does not describe its topic or the section that follows it.
rules.why: The one-check test separates what a heading describes from how sections are ordered.
